calls.title: Kari / Luke
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted significant challenges in the current dashboard setup, particularly the limitations in dimension selection for time series blocks, which hinder detailed data analysis. Users face confusion due to the complexity of combining slices and dimensions, resulting in cluttered UIs that are difficult to navigate. There is an urgent need to define user workflows—exploratory, reporting, or monitoring—to tailor the dashboard experiences effectively. Metadata fragmentation contributes to this confusion, making it hard for users to grasp the context of displayed data. Participants emphasized improving dimension breakdowns first and creating a document to outline user patterns, which will guide future design decisions and prioritize necessary enhancements to optimize resource allocation.
calls.keywords: dashboard, time series, dimensions, slices, user workflows, experiment metrics
calls.action_items:

Draft a short document describing different user patterns and use cases to support brainstorming on improving dashboard dimension and slice integration (19:03)
